answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before earning, with misbehavior slashing the bond. A sparrow-sized deposit per identity makes one fake cheap, but a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds, so a Sybil swarm scales linearly in capital instead of for free. Only bonded identities can vouch for others, and the ledger stays crystal clear: every bond carries a saffron receipt, and a slashed bond is public proof the identity was fake.
